I’m not connected to live sports feeds, so I can’t pull the exact fixture for today’s date.  
Here’s what you can do to find out which Indian Premier League (IPL) match is on:

| Option | How to Use |
|--------|------------|
| **Official IPL App** | Download the *IPL* app (iOS/Android). It shows the full schedule, live scores, and push‑notifications for every match. |
| **IPL Website** | Visit [www.iplt20.com](https://www.iplt20.com). The “Fixtures” tab lists all games with dates, times, venues, and teams. |
| **Sports News Sites** | ESPN Cricinfo, BBC Sport, or Cricbuzz provide daily match previews and live commentary. |
| **TV Guide** | If you’re watching on TV, check the channel’s sports schedule (e.g., Star Sports, Sony Ten). |

If you tell me the date you’re interested in (or just say “today”), I can give you a quick reminder of the usual match‑day format (e.g., most IPL matches run from 4 pm to 10 pm IST). Otherwise, the official sources above will give you the most accurate, up‑to‑date information.
